title: Molecular mechanism of flavonoid-induced iron oxide transformation and implication for phosphorus loss risk in paddy soils
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00177C, Paper
Wenjing Kang, Xiaolei Huang, Zhenyu Peng, Carmen Enid Martínez, Jian Xiao, Wei Ran, Qirong Shen
Flavonoids (e.g., quercetin) boost soil P fixation by forming 2-line ferrihydrite and enlarging Fe–P surface area, reducing P loss naturally.
